机制概述: Vanaah has a Divinity Token she can use to gain extra Power and Priority. This Token returns periodically, and can be used many times throughout a duel.

效果.效果: Regain any Divinity in Discard Pile 2. Put any Divinity in Discard Pile 1 into Discard Pile 2. Put any Divinity depleted this beat into Discard Pile 1.
